listingRule: IN: any landed build that is a watch face when it lands — it carries a clock, a weather call, a camera call, or a Companion call from the screen. Posted at $10 at landing. OUT: containerized Android builds that are not watch faces (container products, CB-class builds) — they keep their already-set pricing schemas.
venue: Interim estate-owned shelf on tinyradr.com, until the appropriate domain name is secured and the builds are pushed to the Play Store.
checkoutState: Posted shelf. Card checkout opens with the licensed launch; until then orders are reserved by email to sales@apexairsolutions.com and the house delivers the posted APK by link.

This is the face in the owner's Nov 6, 2026 LOKMAT field photo, line for line, and every photo line is produced by this file's own code: giant clock (measure-and-jam fit), date line in the toDateString format (FRI NOV 06 2026), the house weather pipe (forecast + conditions proxies) behind the photo's WX 39F and PEAK 11-07 39F 97% lines, the microclimate water line (Lake Michigan −0.8F signed shift), sun and moon markers counter-positioned on the radar-ring dial at their true computed azimuths (closed-form astronomy, no network), neon palette (#00ff88 / #00eeff / #ff3bd4 / #ffb000) on black, circuit traces through the dial. Compass layer failure-isolated as designed: a real heading when a sensor answers, the bearing settles to NO COMPASS when none does - clock and weather unaffected either way (the photo's posture, and the bench's). ISOLATION CUT, verified by diff: one provenance comment added under the title; the six-link app nav grid and the CB faceswap link removed, so the face stands alone and nothing actionable sits in the bottom nav band; every other byte preserved. Honest data posture: where the prediction engine cannot answer, the face holds WX --- / PEAK --- / WATER --- placeholders and invents nothing. PROOF (real render, headless Chromium 480x480): 10/10 - live clock, date line in the photo's format, NO COMPASS on the sensorless bench, sun/moon transforms set by the face's own astronomy, face topmost at 144/144 grid points at both samples, zero page exceptions (record: weather-face-isolation/proof/proof-result.json). NO MEASURE: on-device paint of this isolated copy (the Nov 6 photo is the owner's evidence for the source face); live weather values over the real network path - the bench served the file off-origin, the pipe 404'd, and the placeholders held.

faces.name: Apex Face — The Sextant
faces.title: APEX — THE SEXTANT
faces.note: The Sextant (Nov 16, 2026) - a navigation-instrument face in the Digiframe template line (folder B9): brass horizon dome, computed sun, moon and 20-star sky from the real clock and a named position input, sidereal time, and a fix labelled COMPUTED with its inputs named on the face. Position input: the device position when the host grants it (labelled GPS INPUT); otherwise the house default, Johannesburg, MI 44.981 N 84.496 W, labelled NO FIX - position is NO MEASURE until a field fix is compared against a known position, and the face says so. The math is shown in the readouts: the SUN, MOON and SKY UP lines carry altitude and azimuth as computed. Worked example, two independent workings filed with the build: 2026-11-16 15:00 UTC at the house position - the face's sun reads alt 18.39 / az 144.42 against an independent NOAA-form computation at 18.39 / 144.41 (arcminute class); the moon agrees with an independent Schlyter-form computation within half a degree across three instants, which is the compact lunar series' stated grade. No controls anywhere on the face; nothing in the bottom navigation band. Vanilla single file, real time driven off the frame clock.

faces.name: Apex Face — Radiosphere
faces.title: APEX — RADIOSPHERE
faces.note: Radiosphere (Nov 16, 2026) - the signal-sphere face: the owner's bench proof of the same name (spinning sphere, height = strength, colour = plane) wired for production to the APEX SCAN FEED contract v1, the same contract Globe Tracker reads. The face paints ONLY what the shell publishes and re-reads the feed every frame: height is measured strength on the spec scale (h = 3 + (dBm + 95) x 30/65, floored at 2), colour is the plane (WIFI / BLE / RID / CELL / GNSS), width is a fixed footing stated on the face and never read as data, entries with no strength in the feed stand as footing dots and count as NO MEASURE, unknown planes are never plotted, and at most the 24 strongest are shown with the count stated on the face. Honest states hold in every build: SCAN - NO FEED (the web build has no shell and reports exactly that), SCAN - NO SIGNALS, and FEED STALE when the feed ages past 15 seconds. Receive-only: the face never connects, pairs, probes or transmits. No bench data ships in the production file. Vanilla single file; the clock rides the title box.
